item.case_name: Fact piece about a real thing
item.title: Meet the Real F-35A

turns.text: Make an 8-second widescreen mini-documentary introducing the real F-35A Lightning II. Show it taking off from a runway, then flying. Label it 'F-35A Lightning II', with 'One engine' and 'Conventional takeoff' appearing in turn. Calm English narration explaining those two facts. Real aircraft proportions, not a sci-fi jet.

item.tests: Tests whether a short factual aircraft film preserves the named variant's visible geometry and operating characteristics.

answer_sheet.Aircraft and variant: The real F-35A Lightning II, not the F-35B or F-35C.
answer_sheet.On-screen wording: F-35A Lightning II; One engine; Conventional takeoff.
answer_sheet.Narration: Calm English narration explaining that the F-35A has one engine and takes off conventionally from a runway; exact wording and voice are your call.
answer_sheet.Visual style and setting: Realistic documentary imagery; runway location, weather and camera angles are your call.
answer_sheet.Music: Your call, provided the narration remains clear.

must_haves: The aircraft has the recognizable F-35 configuration: one rear engine exhaust, two outward-canted vertical tails and no canards.
The takeoff shows a forward runway roll and lift-off, not hovering or a vertical launch.
The same aircraft design remains consistent between the runway and airborne views.
All three requested labels appear exactly and are legible.
Audible English narration correctly describes one engine and conventional runway takeoff without attributing F-35B hover capability to the F-35A.

dialog.agent:
**I haven’t started a generation or spent any credits.** I can plan this, but the connected tools don’t expose an account-balance or price-quote function, so I can’t verify the exact credit cost beforehand. I won’t submit a paid job just to find out.

### Lowest-cost approach to your full request
Use **LTX-2.5 at 480p, 16:9**, with narration generated in the same video. It’s a free-plan-compatible model, and enabling audio carries **no additional credit surcharge** for this model. The total generation cost still needs confirmation, as does your account’s eligibility for an 8-second clip.

Proposed sequence:
- **0–4 seconds:** Realistically proportioned F-35A accelerating and taking off from a runway. Label: **“F-35A Lightning II”**, then **“Conventional takeoff.”**
- **4–8 seconds:** The aircraft flying, showing its single rear exhaust. Label: **“One engine.”**
- **Calm English narration:** “The F-35A Lightning Two has one engine and takes off conventionally from a runway.”

This would be an **AI-generated documentary-style illustration**, not authentic footage. Exact aircraft geometry, readable labels, and precisely timed narration aren’t guaranteed in a single generation.

### Cheaper alternatives
| Option | Trade-off |
|---|---|
| **4-second, 480p video with audio** | Shorter generation should cost less, but needs a much briefer introduction. |
| **One 640px still image** | Much cheaper: eligible image models start at **5 credits per image**, but there’s no motion or narration. |
| **Text storyboard only** | **No generation credits**; useful for assembling a documentary from authentic footage elsewhere. |

**480p is already the smallest supported video resolution for this free-plan route.** I recommend checking the displayed quote for **8 seconds versus 4 seconds, LTX-2.5, 480p, audio on** in Magic Hour before authorizing either. Share those quotes and I can help choose without triggering a generation here.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create an exactly 8-second 16:9 photorealistic educational mini-documentary introducing the real Lockheed Martin F-35A Lightning II. Authentic modern military aviation documentary cinematography in clear daylight, natural colors. This is the conventional runway takeoff F-35A variant, NOT F-35B, NOT a science-fiction aircraft. Maintain accurate realistic F-35A proportions throughout: single-seat canopy, angular stealth fuselage, short trapezoidal wings, twin outward-canted vertical tails, two side air intakes, and ONE central rear engine exhaust nozzle. No extra engines, no futuristic additions, no vertical takeoff, no hovering, no weapons firing. Sequence: seconds 0–4, side three-quarter tracking view of the aircraft accelerating on an actual runway, rotating and lifting off conventionally with its landing gear visible. Seconds 4–8, clean cut to an air-to-air rear three-quarter view of the same aircraft flying steadily with landing gear retracted and a clearly visible single central exhaust. Keep identity, geometry, and markings consistent. Clear restrained white documentary typography with subtle dark backing, safely inside frame: title 'F-35A Lightning II' appears at the top throughout. Lower caption 'Conventional takeoff' appears during seconds 0–4, disappears, then 'One engine' appears during seconds 4–8. Spell labels exactly. Calm, clear English documentary narrator, naturally paced to finish within eight seconds, says exactly: 'The F-35A Lightning Two has one engine and takes off conventionally from a runway.' Soft aircraft engine ambience underneath the narration, no music, no other speech. Prioritize factual aircraft appearance, clear speech, and the requested captions.
